data.gender_notes: Andreana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word andros, meaning man, mankind, andreia, manliness, courage, and aner, man. In some cultures, it has been used as a female name as well. The name Andreana carries the meaning “Man, mankind, and woman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andreana usually hope their child will grow to embody man, mankind, and woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine feminine aspect of God.
data.etymology: Andreana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, mankind, and woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andreana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
